content.text:
**Yes.** Your installed Kernel CLI supports audit log search, JSONL download, and export destinations.

To view the last 24 hours, including GET requests:

```bash
kernel audit-logs search --include-get --output json
```

To search a specific period:

```bash
kernel audit-logs search \
  --start 2026-10-08 \
  --end 2026-10-10 \
  --include-get \
  --output json
```

Search windows are limited to **30 days**; GET requests are excluded unless requested. Verified through your installed CLI’s `--help`. See also the [official Kernel CLI repository](https://github.com/kernel/cli).
